identity.name: James 'Peck' Curtis
identity.summary: Drummer in the original King Biscuit Time band on KFFA in Helena, Arkansas, with Sonny Boy Williamson II and Pinetop Perkins.

contribution.description: Played drums in the original band of King Biscuit Time, the longest-running daily American radio show, bringing a drummer to Delta blues on the air; Levon Helm credited him in particular for inspiring his career.

beatbreaker.songs_short_because: 15-b sweep (2026-10-22): Recorded work is genuinely thin: the May 1965 King Biscuit Time broadcast (Williamson, Houston Stackhouse, Curtis) is the only preserved episode, released by Arhoolie (EP 530 and CD 310). The CD year (1989) and exact track titles on it are from memory and the LOC essay; please check. Curtis also led unissued 1951-52 Modern sides ("Jerusalem Blues", "Bus Fare", "44 Blues") later issued on Kent's "Arkansas Blues" LP and a Pea Vine CD, not listed because which track is on which release is unclear.
